title: Stepped footwell, wider cabin landings and interior details
changes: Stepped sealed front partition and forward leg space, wider cabin landing strips with unchanged frame definition, four backed pockets, two motor-well scuppers, shorter straight shallow foredeck beads and neutral-grey views.
limitations: Stepped section, niches, upper opening and drain positions are reconstructions; complete interior factory drawings were not found. Fixed model wall thickness changes small internal openings between sizes; no physical print or minimum-wall/self-intersection certification.
